answer: Verifiers stake $50 per identity they stamp, on a spiral, the hundredth identity in a batch costs a hundred times the first, so one verifier stamping 100 clones locks $252,500. Each verifier also locks a $120 ferrous chip bond no machine can copy. Three auditors re-check 5 percent of stamps each epoch; one fake lights the ember bond, burning the whole batch stake and voiding every identity. Split across 100 verifiers, 100 clones still cost $17,000, gone on first detection, against $0 net for 100 honest agents. Forging identities here is paying to light your own money on fire.
